what: The aider apprentice's SECOND drive that landed an applied edit (2026-08-18T05:25:44Z, ticket a-false-statement-in-a-trouble-record-can-be-corrected-in-place, piece 0, qwen3-coder:30b on hex). It wrote a substantially correct TroubleDevice.amend AND destroyed TroubleDevice.clear in the same act, and both halves are measured rather than judged.

the_measurement.test: python3 cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble.py — returncode 1, and the stderr is a TypeError, not an assertion: "'NoneType' object is not subscriptable" at test_an_off_template_record_can_still_leave_through_the_door

the_defect: IT EMITTED TWO SEARCH/REPLACE BLOCKS FOR ONE METHOD. The second block is the real one — a complete amend appended after clear(), resolving the {in, at} join key against the named list, refusing when no entry carries that `at`, appending to an `amendments` list, touching neither standing nor count, and emitting a GATE CONTACT breadcrumb in the lane's own idiom. The FIRST block anchored on the tail of clear()'s docstring and inserted a SIGNATURE-AND-DOCSTRING-ONLY amend immediately after it. The result parsed, imported, and passed nothing: clear() became a docstring-only stub returning None, its entire body was re-parented under the stub amend, and two `def amend` now stood in one class. Measured after the drive: `grep -n '    def '` showed amend at :203 and again at :243, and clear() at :194 with no body.
why_it_matters: THE FAILURE IS NOT ABOUT THE MODEL'S GRASP OF THE TASK. It understood the design — the join key, the refusal, the untouched standing/count, the breadcrumb — and wrote it correctly once. What it could not do is emit exactly one edit. That is a distinction the survival probe's vocabulary already needs: `not-applied` and `discarded` were the two states, and this is a third — APPLIED AND SELF-CANCELLING, where the edit lands, aider reports success, and the file is worse than before.
the_shim_finding_this_surfaced: `auto_test=False` IN THE DRIVER (driver.py:279, comment 'WE run the test, so its result is ours to carry') SEVERS max_reflections FROM test_cmd. aider reflects on `self.reflected_message`, which auto_test is what sets from a failing test; with it off, the driver runs the test AFTER coder.run() returns and the apprentice never learns it failed. This drive passed max_reflections=1 and recorded num_reflections=0 — not because the apprentice converged, but because nothing could reach it. The convergence loop the standing intention needs does not exist yet, and the field that looks like it is the one that proves it does not.
disposition: The edit was REVERTED (git checkout -- cairn/devices/trouble/trouble.py; the 19 pre-existing teeth are green again at 19/19). Hand-repairing it would have made the survival probe count a surviving edit that a human finished — the number is only worth having if it is the apprentice's. The drives.jsonl row carries the honest outcome and is the evidence.
the_other_measurement_from_the_same_hour: THE FIRST attempt at this drive (2026-08-18T05:21:27Z, row 9) died at the fence with HostUnmetered — hex answered with {model: '', created_at: '0001-01-01T00:00:00Z', done: false} and no token counters. Reproduced OUTSIDE Cairn with a bare curl to http://hex.local:11434/api/chat, so it is the host's behaviour and not the shim's. It cleared on its own: the same call at num_ctx 4096/32768/65536/81920 answered normally and metered on every subsequent attempt, and an alternating 4096<->81920 sequence did not reproduce it. Intermittent, host-side, ollama 0.30.11, model qwen3-coder:30b loaded at context_length 81920 with 26.5GB in VRAM. THE FENCE BEHAVED CORRECTLY: it refused rather than defaulting the cost to 0, and — because of the repair that landed earlier the same day — it RECORDED the failed ask, so the driver could say 'one ask, none allowed' instead of the false 'reached no model'.

the_three_defects: ITS `enough` IS VACUOUS AND ITS OWN DOCSTRING SAYS SO: 'the fact that it was written means it reached a writer, and by definition it must have reached a reader to be recorded'. That is the volume-buys-it failure hypothesis 5's falsifier named in advance — satisfied by writing an amendment, with no reader involved. _trigger and _enough are also the same function under two names.

IT GLOBS THE WRONG ROOT AND THE WRONG DIRECTORY: _CLASS_SPACE.glob('**/trouble/*.json') searches class-space for a store that lives in CairnCommons/troubles/. It would count 0 forever and its red would be right for the wrong reason.
